title: JudgeResult
description: One PASS/FAIL verdict per criterion the judge was asked to evaluate. Mirrors the JudgeResult pydantic model used with client.messages.parse().

verdicts.description: Exactly one entry per criterion id supplied under CRITERIA TO JUDGE, in the same order.

criterion_id.description: The id of the criterion being judged, copied verbatim from the bracketed id in CRITERIA TO JUDGE.

verdict.description: Whether the student artifact satisfies this criterion.

evidence.description: A verbatim span copied from the student artifact that justifies the verdict. Empty string when nothing in the artifact bears on the criterion.

confidence.description: How clearly the artifact settles this criterion. Use low for ambiguous or borderline calls.
